items.title: Wynn Resorts (NASDAQ:WYNN) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations, Stock Soars
items.summary: Luxury hotels and casino operator Wynn Resorts (NASDAQ:WYNN) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 6.9% year on year to $1.86 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.24 per share was 26.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
